cancelled.note: 200 with an empty JSON object — not 204, and not an empty body. This is also what releases a held `display_and_wait` request, which then answers 410 FI.MAU.BRIDGE.LOGIN_CANCELLED.

already_gone.note: Cancelling a process the bridge has already forgotten. The Gateway treats this as success on purpose: the login is over either way, which is what was asked for.

body.error: User does not have login permissions
